lines.text: Underneath these stars I’m making you this vow
No matter where life takes us, I’ll be here right now
Through every twist and turning, every high and low
My heart is yours completely, just so you know
The night is quiet, but my promise is loud
Written in the heavens, wrapped in every cloud
Starlit promise, shining just for you
Every wish I ever made is finally coming true
I’ll hold you close when the dark feels wide
Starlit promise, forever by your side
